Subject: Hosted API evaluation request — Fathom Labs

Hi Kimberly,

I signed up via the hosted API sandbox earlier today (thanks for the easy onboarding!). We're evaluating Redwood for a prototype that needs fast token throughput and predictable latency. Would love a short 30-minute hosted API evaluation to walk through the runtime, recommended batching strategies, and how to set up prefix caching.

Our team is in PDT — mornings are best for us. Are there any openings this week (June 2–4) between 9–11am PT? Two of us will join initially (me and our engineering lead).

A couple of quick context points:
- We're running short transcripts (~256 tokens) with bursty spikes.
- Cost is a concern; we'd like guidance on batching + quantization suggestions.

Thanks — looking forward to connecting.

Alex Morgan
Head of Integrations, Fathom Labs
